title: Tom Gilb (Planguage inventor) ships an 'Incorruptible AI Agent' that scores plans against Eric's principles
summary: Tom Gilb — inventor of Planguage, veteran software-methodology author, and consultant to international engineering organizations — demos a new AI agent built into his Planguage SIM platform on the August Datocracy call. Tom fed the entire Incorruptible book (plus Eric's additional chapters) into the agent, which then reviews any plan against Ries's principles, generates an overall 'incorruptibility score', flags mission drift and governance gaps, and records every accepted or rejected recommendation as an auditable trail. A companion 'Sharpen' workflow turns the agent into an interactive planning partner. Third-party productization of the book's ideas by a heavyweight methodology voice.
blockquote: Tom demonstrated a new SIM agent that evaluates plans against Eric Ries' Incorruptible principles, generates an incorruptibility score, proposes targeted improvements, and records every accepted or rejected recommendation as part of a permanent decision trail.
attribution_title: Inventor of Planguage; consultant, methods inventor, textbook author
